plugin.name: Peter Jackson's King Kong Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
RawInputMouse.description: Use raw mouse input for camera movement. Needs a restart.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view, up to 150 degrees horizontally. Culling stays wide enough for the camera.
WindowedMode.description: Run the game in a borderless window.
VSync.description: Synchronize Direct3D 9 presentation to the display refresh rate.
FPSLimit.description: 0 is unlimited; -1 follows the monitor refresh rate. Changes apply while playing. Rates above 60 can break gameplay.
FPSLimitMode.description: Use 1 for a busy wait or 2 for a sleep and yield limiter.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the native fix menu language. Auto uses a supported detected language, or English when detection or translation is unavailable. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplier on the game’s mouse sensitivity. Changes apply while playing when raw input is enabled.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game while its window is inactive. Off keeps the engine running in the background.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Releases it immediately when disabled or unfocused.
CheckForUpdates.description: Checks once for a newer fix when enabled. Off makes no network request. The notice appears in Plugins; FusionFixHub opens after exit when available.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: {name} {version} is available. Get the update at fusionfix.io.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto spreads the HUD and on-screen text over the whole screen. A ratio keeps them in a centred box of that shape. Menus keep their 16:9 layout on wider screens.
